nirvana.kit_batch_instructions:
@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
echo ============================================
echo   Disaster recovery - bring your companion back
echo ============================================
echo.
echo Read README.md first, then follow these steps:
echo.
echo   1) Check this machine:   python check.py
echo   2) Restore from USB:    python restore.py --file backup_XXXX.tar.gz
echo.
echo If python is unavailable, install Python 3.12 first.
echo.
pause
